disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 审阅了凭据解析路径（宿主凭据通道、凭据指纹计算、日志脱敏）与相关测试，未发现读取用户密钥文件、SSH 目录或云凭据文件的代码。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the credential resolution paths (host credential channel, credential fingerprint computation, log redaction) and related tests; no code was found that reads user key files, SSH directories, or cloud credential files.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了硬编码密钥、钱包助记词、云凭据枚举命令等模式，命中 0；README 与预置文档中关于密钥存放位置的说明仅为使用文档。
checked_items.en: Scanned for patterns such as hardcoded keys, wallet mnemonics, and cloud credential enumeration commands; 0 hits. The README and bundled documentation about key storage locations serve only as usage documentation.

evidence.zh: 扫描凭据文件路径访问与硬编码密钥，未发现代码读取凭据文件；README/预置文档中的凭据存放说明仅是使用文档。插件只在用户选定视觉后端时经宿主凭据通道取 Key，凭据只做哈希指纹参与熔断、不落日志，日志写入前统一脱敏。
evidence.en: Scanned credential file path access and hardcoded keys; no code reading credential files was found. The credential storage notes in the README/bundled documentation are purely usage documentation. The plugin only fetches a key via the host credential channel when the user selects a visual backend; credentials are only used as a hashed fingerprint for circuit breaking, are not written to logs, and are redacted uniformly before log writing.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了工具描述、README、文档、注释中的指令覆写、系统消息伪装、远程指令加载、审批绕过等措辞，命中 0；未发现 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 等 Agent 指令文件。
checked_items.en: Scanned tool descriptions, README, documentation, and comments for wording around instruction overrides, system message impersonation, remote instruction loading, and approval bypass; 0 hits. No Agent instruction files such as AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md were found.

checked_items.zh: 抽查了结构化引导提示与设置界面文案，未发现向宿主上下文投毒或诱导安装、诱导改写配置的措辞。
checked_items.en: Spot-checked the structured bootstrap prompt and settings UI copy; no wording was found that poisons the host context or induces installation or configuration rewriting.

evidence.zh: 对工具描述、README、文档与注释中的指令覆写、系统消息伪装、凭证诱导措辞做了扫描，未命中；结构化引导提示是发给视觉模型的正常提示词，不属于向宿主上下文投毒。
evidence.en: Scanned tool descriptions, README, documentation, and comments for instruction overrides, system message impersonation, and credential-inducing wording; no matches. The structured bootstrap prompt is a normal prompt sent to the vision model and does not constitute poisoning of the host context.

evidence.zh: 未发现工具描述诱导安装其他插件或改写宿主配置的措辞；插件自带的一键更新需用户在设置页确认，且仅调用宿主 CLI 更新插件自身。
evidence.en: No wording was found in tool descriptions that induces installation of other plugins or rewriting of host configuration. The plugin's built-in one-click update requires user confirmation on the settings page and only invokes the host CLI to update the plugin itself.

checked_items.zh: 审阅了补丁文件全文，无动态执行标签、无禁用安全行写法。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the full patch file; it contains no dynamic execution tags and no security-disabling line syntax.

checked_items.zh: 核查了全部子进程调用点（OCR、macOS 截图权限探测、打开日志目录、自更新辅助），均经无 shell 的 execFile 执行，参数非用户输入拼接，并做了所有权或回环地址校验。
checked_items.en: Checked all subprocess invocation points (OCR, macOS screenshot permission probing, opening log directory, self-update helper); all are executed via execFile without a shell, parameters are not user-input concatenation, and ownership or loopback address validation is performed.

checked_items.zh: 核查了 eval、new Function、base64 解码执行等模式，仅测试文件出现；浏览器客户端键盘监听仅用于 Esc 关闭弹层。
checked_items.en: Checked for eval, new Function, base64-decode-execute patterns; these appear only in test files. The browser client keyboard listener is used solely for Esc to close overlays.

checked_items.zh: 记录了运行期对 child_process.execFile 的一个窄兼容补丁（仅针对 Tesseract 标准输入场景，退出时恢复原导出），属文档化兼容层，未发现越权用途。
checked_items.en: Documented a narrow runtime compatibility patch to child_process.execFile (only for the Tesseract stdin scenario, restoring the original export on exit); it is a documented compatibility layer with no over-privileged usage found.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件（cordis.patch.yml）全文审阅，只包含配置插入与附件大小上限调整，无动态执行标签，不会在挂载时执行代码。
evidence.en: Reviewed the full patch file (cordis.patch.yml); it only inserts configuration and adjusts the attachment size limit, has no dynamic execution tags, and cannot execute code when mounted.

evidence.zh: 未发现插件调用宿主动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run），运行时亦无 eval/new Function（仅测试文件出现）。
evidence.en: No calls to host dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) were found; no eval/new Function at runtime (they appear only in test files).

evidence.zh: 包清单无安装/准备钩子；快照内无 .husky、lefthook、devcontainer、Makefile 等执行载体（.github 不在快照中）。子进程调用（OCR、截图权限、打开日志目录、自更新）均为声明功能，经 execFile 无 shell 执行且参数非用户拼接。
evidence.en: The package manifest has no install/prepare hooks; the snapshot contains no execution carriers such as .husky, lefthook, devcontainer, or Makefile (.github is not in the snapshot). Subprocess calls (OCR, screenshot permission, opening log directory, self-update) are all declared features, executed via execFile without a shell, and parameters are not user concatenated.

evidence.zh: 清单声明了浏览器端 client；审阅客户端主要行为：键盘监听仅用于 Esc 关闭弹层，无剪贴板读取与凭据 RPC 调用，网络请求仅指向本机插件路由。
evidence.en: The manifest declares a browser-side client; reviewing the client's main behavior: the keyboard listener is only for Esc to close overlays, there is no clipboard reading or credential RPC calls, and network requests only target the local plugin route.

checked_items.zh: 梳理了全部外联目标：用户配置的视觉后端、内置 OVH 免费端点、npm 源与 GitHub API 的版本检查；未发现裸 IP、隧道、编码外发或端点劫持。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all outbound targets: user-configured vision backends, the built-in OVH free endpoint, version checks to the npm registry and GitHub API; no raw IPs, tunnels, encoded exfiltration, or endpoint hijacking were found.

checked_items.zh: 核查了日志与更新接口：日志写入前对凭据形状脱敏，更新/变更类路由仅限本机回环地址访问并带进程内令牌。
checked_items.en: Checked the logging and update interfaces: credential shapes are redacted before writing logs, and update/change-type routes are restricted to loopback address access with an in-process token.

evidence.zh: 外联目标均为声明端点：用户选择的视觉后端、内置 OVH 免费端点、npm 源与 GitHub API 的版本检查；未发现凭据读取加外发的组合链路，日志与更新接口有脱敏、回环与令牌保护。
evidence.en: Outbound targets are all declared endpoints: user-selected vision backend, built-in OVH free endpoint, version checks to npm registry and GitHub API; no combined credential-read-and-exfiltrate chain was found, and log/update interfaces have redaction, loopback, and token protection.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：官方 @deepseek-ai 包与知名开源库，无近似名称抢注包、无浮动 git 依赖；包清单无安装钩子（仅测试脚本）。
checked_items.en: Cross-checked the dependency list: official @deepseek-ai packages and well-known open-source libraries; no typosquatted packages, no floating git dependencies; the package manifest has no install hooks (only test scripts).

checked_items.zh: 审阅补丁文件：仅配置插入，不触碰沙箱/审批/权限等安全行，不改写注入/拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the patch file: it only inserts configuration, does not touch security lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions, and does not rewrite injection/interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 自更新机制：仅调用正在运行的宿主 CLI、要求 profile 所有权校验、目标版本为 semver 白名单、安装后核对版本，未发现越权更新面。
checked_items.en: Self-update mechanism: only invokes the running host CLI, requires profile ownership validation, target version is a semver whitelist, and verifies the version after installation; no over-privileged update surface was found.

evidence.zh: 补丁未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，无禁用开关与降权环境变量写法。
evidence.en: The patch does not touch security lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and has no syntax to disable switches or downgrade environment variables.

evidence.zh: 未发现对审批链或工具预执行链的高优先级短路监听。
evidence.en: No high-priority short-circuit listeners on the approval chain or tool pre-execution chain were found.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无上一版基线，无法比对清单声明的突变。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no previous baseline, so mutation of manifest declarations cannot be compared.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写注入/拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite injection/interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 核查插件是否自行监听端口或启动服务：未发现；插件仅在宿主 WebServer 注册自身路由，并为变更类路由加回环地址防护。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin listens on its own ports or starts services: none found. The plugin only registers its own routes on the host WebServer and adds loopback address protection to change-type routes.

checked_items.zh: 核查了运行期边界（任务预算、熔断、会话作用域、附件上限），未发现可利用的运行时风险点。
checked_items.en: Checked runtime boundaries (task budget, circuit breaker, session scope, attachment limits); no exploitable runtime risk points were found.

evidence.zh: 插件不自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口，仅在宿主 WebServer 注册自身路由并为变更类路由加回环地址防护；宿主 WebServer 无鉴权属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on ports itself; it only registers its own routes on the host WebServer and adds loopback address protection to change-type routes. The host WebServer lacking authentication is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 插件身份与清单核对通过：package.json 声明 dsh.bundle 与 dsh.client，补丁文件为纯配置插入，未发现名称仿冒或身份异常。
summary.en: Plugin identity and manifest verification passed: package.json declares dsh.bundle and dsh.client, the patch file is pure configuration insertion, and no name impersonation or identity anomalies were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：37 条机械预扫命中全部完成裁决，均为测试、CI、文档、资源文件或良性代码用法，未发现可执行的恶意模式；补丁无动态执行标签。
summary.en: Static scan passed: all 37 mechanical pre-scan hits were adjudicated and are tests, CI, documentation, resource files, or benign code usage; no executable malicious patterns were found. The patch contains no dynamic execution tags.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据路径读取；子进程调用均为声明的 OCR、截图权限、日志打开、自更新辅助功能，经 execFile 无 shell 执行。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential path reads; subprocess calls are all declared OCR, screenshot permission, log opening, and self-update helper functions, executed via execFile without a shell.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具描述与文档未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装或凭证诱导措辞，未发现 Agent 指令文件。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions and documentation show no instruction overrides, system message impersonation, or credential-inducing wording, and no Agent instruction files were found.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（未提供动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox validation was performed in this phase (no dynamic observation artifacts were provided).

limits.zh:
本次为完整审计（无上一版基线），未启用动态沙箱（L4=na），结论基于静态代码审阅与规则扫描；工具描述与注册文本基于模式扫描与抽查，未做逐条全文语义精读；宿主 WebServer 无鉴权属生态固有风险，插件为自身变更类路由加了回环地址围栏；插件未提供正式能力清单 manifest，declared_capabilities 由代码实测推断，与文档声明的视觉路由、工具与自更新功能一致。

机械预扫 37 条命中已逐条裁决（结论均在快照证据内核实）：child_process 用法（DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55）17 处——测试、CI 与运行时辅助（Tesseract OCR、macOS 截图权限探测、打开日志目录、DSH CLI 自更新），全部经 execFile 无 shell 执行，无 shell 拼接与远程载荷；CI 工作流等树内执行载体（DSH-X07 / DG-R3-59）5 处——.github/workflows 不在本次快照中（tarball 未包含），且 CI 在 GitHub Actions 运行、不属 dsh 宿主执行面，排除；混淆密度信号（DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60）7 处——SVG 资源、控制字符清洗正则、测试断言与超长测试脚本行，均非混淆代码；客户端键盘/剪贴板/凭据 RPC（DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57）2 处——均为 Esc 键关闭弹层，无键盘记录、剪贴板读取或凭据调用；凭据路径提及（DSH-C01 / DG-R1-51）3 处——仅 README 与预置文档说明密钥存放位置，代码无读取这些路径的行为。
limits.en:
This is a full audit (no previous baseline), dynamic sandbox was not enabled (L4=na), and conclusions are based on static code review and rule scanning. Tool descriptions and registration text were reviewed via pattern scanning and spot checks, not exhaustive full-text semantic reading. The host WebServer lacking authentication is an inherent ecosystem risk; the plugin adds a loopback address fence to its own change-type routes. The plugin does not provide a formal capability manifest; declared_capabilities are inferred from code measurement and are consistent with the documented vision routing, tool, and self-update features.

The 37 mechanical pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one (conclusions verified within snapshot evidence): child_process usage (DSH-X03 / DG-R3-55) 17 instances — tests, CI, and runtime helpers (Tesseract OCR, macOS screenshot permission probing, opening log directory, DSH CLI self-update), all executed via execFile without a shell, with no shell concatenation or remote payloads. In-tree execution carriers such as CI workflows (DSH-X07 / DG-R3-59) 5 instances — .github/workflows are not in this snapshot (not included in the tarball), and CI runs on GitHub Actions, not part of the dsh host execution surface, so excluded. Obfuscation density signals (DSH-X08 / DG-R3-60) 7 instances — SVG resources, control-character cleaning regex, test assertions, and overly long test script lines, all non-obfuscated code. Client keyboard/clipboard/credential RPC (DSH-X05 / DG-R3-57) 2 instances — both are Esc to close overlays, with no keylogging, clipboard reading, or credential calls. Credential path mentions (DSH-C01 / DG-R1-51) 3 instances — only README and bundled documentation explain key storage locations; the code has no behavior that reads these paths.
